record.question: As per section 11(1) ND&PS Rules 2022, Except in cases of opium, ganja and charas (hashish), where a quantity of not less than _______shall be drawn for each sample, in all other cases not less than five grams shall be drawn for each sample and the same quantity shall be taken for the duplicate sample.
record.explanation: For opium, ganja and charas, not less than 24 grams is drawn for each sample.
